completed.4.30: OKX.AI listing rejection (round 4): -32603 'x402 middleware timeout after 25000ms' with empty txHash (signed authorization never settled). Root cause: src/server.ts with402Body raced the OKX x402 middleware against a 25s application timer. Once verify succeeded the SDK buffered the response until OpenRouter returned and then settled, but the app injected -32603 before that, so the SDK skipped settlement and replayed the fake 500 to the buyer. Three structural fixes shipped in commit 6fca22b: (a) with402Body race removed entirely — the SDK now owns the full verify->execute->settle lifecycle; (b) checker.ts getClient bounded to timeout=60s, maxRetries=1 so the full call fits the x402 300s auth window; (c) check-continuity tool errors now throw (not return isError:true), the /mcp route catch returns HTTP 500, and the x402 middleware sees statusCode>=400 and skips settlement — buyers are not charged for failed work. probe:paid rewritten as a strict canary: requires 200 + JSON-RPC 2.0 result + PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header; -32603/internal_error/timeout/missing txHash all FAIL with exit 1; 180s client timeout. Funded canary passed end-to-end on the deployed fix: unpaid 402 -> sign -> paid 200 in 8985ms with a real Aria eye-color flag (high severity, blue -> red with green iris) + PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement header. Ready for OKX re-submission.
completed.4.31: OKX.AI listing rejection (round 5, David Shui, 2026-07-24 15:25): x402 GET challenge returns valid 402, but paid GET replay gets status 0 / 'error sending request' on POST replay despite on-chain settle (txHash 0x4a301c04..., $0.10 charged). Railway HTTP logs (sfo, deployment 32e5e0c0) proved paid replays arrived as GET /mcp, not POST — three entries from the review window at 13:54:40 (GET 499 after 29957ms, txBytes=0, 'client has closed the request before the server could send a response'), 13:56:08 (same pattern), 14:18:25 (same pattern). Two root causes: (1) installed OKX core extractPayment() ignores X-PAYMENT — Express adapter reads it into unused context, actual extraction only checks PAYMENT-SIGNATURE; (2) paid GET routed to MCP SSE via handleMcpHttp, never ending under x402 buffering → 30s proxy timeout → 499. Fixes in commit 7ffdf7b: (a) /mcp-scoped middleware aliases X-PAYMENT to PAYMENT-SIGNATURE when canonical header absent (server.ts:365-377); (b) GET /mcp handler replaced with synchronous JSON-RPC tools list response via res.json() — no SSE, immediate end so x402 settle+flush completes in one message (server.ts:634-661); (c) new probe-okx-replay.ts canary matching the reviewer's exact wire flow: Phase A = unpaid GET 402 -> sign -> paid GET require 200 + JSON-RPC result + PAYMENT-RESPONSE in <30s; Phase B = fresh GET 402 -> sign -> POST tools/list same requirements. Both phases passed on deployed Railway: paid GET in 900ms, paid POST in 964ms, both with settlement proof. All background sessions reconciled. Test payer depleted (0.2 USDT -> 0). Ready for re-submission.

completed.6.00: JAM PIVOT — strategic reframe for Creative Minds Jam #1 (deadline 2026-08-28 15:59 UTC). Audited Mnemo against the jam's 5 equal-weight criteria: scored ~31/50 because Minds Integration Depth was 2/10 (zero Minds — OpenRouter/Gemini only) and Creator-Economy Problem Fit was 5/10 (webtoon continuity QA matches none of the 3 tracks). Swapping Gemini→Mind was rejected as a model swap that fails the sponsor-centrality test. Decision: keep the canon-memory engine (structured facts + per-episode ep_ref provenance + self-updating canon_additions = literally the jam's 'memory/continuity/autonomous follow-up' requirement), replace the surface, land in Track 3 as a spoiler-aware community moderator that computes spoiler risk relative to each reader's progress. Projected ~42/50. Researched the Minds platform: conversations with stable aliases + getHistory = native cross-session memory, image/PDF attachments = vision works, SSE subscribeEvents = filmable autonomy, Bazaar skills/apps, cognition metered incl. autonomous work; NO documented way to register a custom HTTP endpoint as a first-class Mind tool, so architecture is backend-orchestrates-Mind. Rejected explicitly: multi-genre pipelines (8-15h, 0 rubric points, lowers Execution), continuity-QA-as-headline, Discord bot (OAuth/hosting risk), further x402 work (not in rubric — cite listing as viability only). Locked: in-app community feed, Lore Olympus with hand-authored canon spanning ep 1-50, demo becomes /, marketing to /mcp-service, add-don't-revamp on the UI, screen-recording video with no motion graphics.

TWO fixes during the run: (1) ROOT-CAUSE of a stale-reply corruption — c20 was cached with a verbatim copy of c19's reply (the Mind answer analyzing Demeter for the color-palette comment). Diagnosis: waitForReply's afterFingerprint was snapshot from HISTORY, but a reply that arrived via SSE and isn't committed to history yet gets re-delivered on the next wait and passes the filter.
